subject: Error when trying to fit a Multilevel Structural Equation Model with lavaan

messages.author: d7b39df239c8a935
messages.subject: Error when trying to fit a Multilevel Structural Equation Model with lavaan
parts:
Hi there

I found this presentation about using lavaan for multilevel sems:  http://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/zurich2017/MULTILEVEL/lavaan_multilevel_zurich2017.pdf

When I try to replicate following code on page 63, I get this error message: Error in W.tilde - Sigma.hat[[g]] : non-conformable arrays

Data <- read.table("http://statmodel.com/usersguide/chap9/ex9.6.dat")
names(Data) <- c("y1", "y2", "y3", "y4", "x1", "x2", "w", "clus")
head(Data)

library(lavaan)
model <- '
        level: 1
          fw =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
          fw ~ x1 + x2
        
        level: 2
          fb =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
          # optional
          y1 ~~ 0*y1
          y2 ~~ 0*y2
          y3 ~~ 0*y3
          y4 ~~ 0*y4
          fb ~ w
'
fit <- sem(model, data = Data,
           cluster = "clus",
           fixed.x = FALSE)

I googled the error but couldn't find a solution for this problem. Any help is much appreciated.

Thanks!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error when trying to fit a Multilevel Structural Equation Model with lavaan
parts:
You need to install the development version (0.6) to use the multilevel
stuff. You can install by typing in R:

install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type =
"source")

Yves.
